data.title: Another Bitcoin miner pivots to AI after a brutal quarter
data.description: Keel Infrastructure (Nasdaq: KEEL), formerly known as Bitcoin miner Bitfarms, reported another loss-making quarter as it completes its exit from Bitcoin mining and redirects its infrastructure toward AI and high-performance computing (HPC).
